spanish: Y acercó ofrenda del pueblo, y tomó macho cabrío del pecado que al pueblo, y lo degolló, y lo hizo pecado como el primero.
grammarChanges: Changed "lo pecó" (qal sense, as if the goat sinned) to "lo hizo pecado" to carry the piel stem force of h03009015012, an action done to the goat, not an action by it.
readerNote: Chose the causative Spanish form "lo hizo pecado" to render the piel stem acting on the goat, since Spanish "pecar" cannot take a direct object.
